name: Kazerne Dirk
description: Designed by Hendrik Leguyt and opened in 1897, Dirk is the historic working fire station beside the Museumplein. Its three arched vehicle doors sit below a carved Brandweer plaque; stepped brick gables carry Amsterdam’s arms. The 2021–2023 renovation restored hidden decorated masonry and brought the monument to gas-free operation. Its name preserves the letter D for Duivelseiland from the earlier station.
facts: Opened as a fire station in 1897; BAG records construction in 1896.
The national monument includes Honthorststraat25–27 and Hobbemakade12.
The 2023 restoration exposed original decorative masonry in the vehicle hall.
